title: mac-sandbox Config
description: Configuration for the mac-sandbox wrapper. Lives at ~/.config/mac-sandbox/<app>.json.

program.description: Override the binary name to launch. Defaults to the app name inferred from the wrapper filename (e.g. opencode-sandbox → opencode). Use this when the installed alias name differs from the real binary name.

sandbox_enabled.description: Set to false to skip sandbox-exec and run the app directly (useful for debugging).

allowed_directories.description: Paths the app may read and write (your project directories). Supports ** glob (e.g. ~/repositories/**).

state_dirs.description: Directories the app itself needs to read and write for its own config, data, and state (e.g. ~/.config/opencode/, ~/.local/share/opencode/). Always granted write access inside the sandbox.

network.description: Network access level inside the sandbox.

process_spawning.description: Whether the app may spawn child processes (git, shells, compilers, etc.).

deny_privilege_escalation.description: Deny system-privilege operations (setuid execution, capability changes). Approximates PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS on Linux. Safe to enable for most CLI tools.

description.description: Free-text note about this config (not used by the script).
